title: About Me
text: I’m Srestha Datta — a data analyst with a thing for problems that sit at the intersection of consumer behavior, brand strategy, and numbers.

title: About Me
text:
Background

Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science — University of Burdwan (2020)

title: About Me
text:
Experience
Obagi Medical — Project Manager, Analytics Capstone (2026) Led a team of 5 on a year-long client engagement. Built an end-to-end analytics workflow on 580K+ rows of sales data, developed two predictive models, and delivered a Tableau dashboard with a live ROI simulator to the client sales team.
HSBC — Senior Analyst, Pune (2023–2024) Managed a pipeline of 200+ monthly CRM leads, drove $43K+ in combined annual revenue targets, and maintained weekly KPI dashboards for management.

title: About Me
text:
Interests
CPG, beauty, retail, and digital marketing analytics. I’m particularly drawn to spaces where the data is rich, the decisions are fast, and the consumer is at the center of everything.

title: Srestha Datta
text:
I build analytics workflows that turn raw, complex data into decisions businesses can actually act on.
I’m completing my MS in Business Analytics at UC Irvine’s Paul Merage School of Business, adding to an MBA from NMIMS and a Computer Science engineering degree. The combination means I can move fluidly between technical teams, marketing functions, and executive stakeholders.
My recent work spans revenue impact modeling for a real skincare brand client, Airbnb pricing analytics across 13,500+ listings, retail customer segmentation for ZARA, and geospatial water quality prediction for EY’s 2026 global AI challenge.
I’m particularly drawn to CPG, beauty, retail, and digital marketing analytics — spaces where consumer behavior, brand strategy, and data intersect in ways that are both analytically rich and genuinely fun to work on.
